metadata.description: Chatito — a Simplified Technical English plugin for Claude. It puts readability first. Output gets shorter as a side effect of the language rules, not as a goal.

plugins.name: simple-english
plugins.description: Simplified Technical English for expository writing — chat replies, commit messages, PR descriptions, code comments, and documents. Raises readability first and cuts length second. Two skills (all prose, or documents only), a linter, and an opt-in output style.
